record.reason: The paper studies learned sparse attention, gate co-adaptation, and post-hoc sparsification with some Qwen3 evaluation. Primary results show deployment quality penalties and limited scale/generalization, making it useful as a limitation/negative-result source rather than a confirmed efficient method.
record.title: Routing Absorption in Sparse Attention: Why Random Gates Are Hard to Beat
